definitions.full: H6300. Pedahel מְּדַהְאֵל proper name, masculine ( El hath ransomed ; compare Phoenician בעלפדה ; Assyrian Pudu-ilu, Pudi-ilu COT Glossary ); — prince of Naphtali Num 34:28 ; Φαδαηλ .
